og/01-the-age-of-hand-forged-code.png.alt: Glurp, turned three-quarters, raises a hammer over their head to strike a glowing bar of code on an anvil set with keycaps, sparks flying. Beside it: Chapter 1, The Age of Hand-Forged Code.

og/02-the-crystal-ball.png.alt: A close-up of Glurp leaning over the crystal ball cupped in both hands, brow raised, its three rings glowing lime in their eyes. Beside it: Chapter 2, The Crystal Ball.

og/03-the-coming-of-the-agents.png.alt: Glurp leans back, startled, arms flung up and brow high, as a swarm of small agents rushes in from the left and gold tokens fly from their pocket. Beside it: Chapter 3, The Coming of the Agents.

og/04-the-five-wounds.png.alt: Glurp sits on a crate with a bandage round their head and a plaster on their cheek, clutching a torn token pouch while gold tokens leak from it onto the floor. Beside it: Chapter 4, The Five Wounds.

og/05-finding-the-meter.png.alt: Glurp stands grinning with both arms high, holding the token gauge aloft as rays of light burst from it. Beside it: Chapter 5, Finding the Meter.

og/06-the-cousin-who-conducts-the-horde..alt: Glurp points at cousin Glorp's raised baton with a question mark overhead; Glorp, indigo in a teal coat, holds it high and answers with an exclamation mark, music notes above the head. Beside it: Chapter 6, The Cousin Who Conducts the Horde.

og/07-glurp-joins-discord.png.alt: Glurp, grinning, leans in on a stool and types fast at a laptop while chat bubbles float up from the screen and Ork Bot watches from the rafters. Beside it: Chapter 7, Glurp Joins Discord.

og/08-epilogue.png.alt: Seen from behind, Glurp sits at their desk late at night, still and calm, lit by the glowing crystal ball, a fresh prompt on the screen and Sir Quackington on the monitor. Beside it: Chapter 8, Epilogue — By the Light of the Ball.

og/contents.png.alt: The eight chapter tableaus of Glurp's story in two rows, over the title Contents.

og/glossary.png.alt: Glurp reads an open scroll held in both hands. Beside them: Glossary of Orkish Developer Terms.

og/quotes.png.alt: Glurp shrugs, palms up, one eyebrow raised. Beside them: Glurp-isms.

og/tooltip.png.alt: Glurp points to the right, making a point. Beside them: Tooltip.
